address_parts.name: address_parts
address_parts.value: address = name || '@' || domain and name ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,30}$' and char_length(domain) between 3 and 253

change_words.name: change_words
change_words.value: char_length(kind) <= 2000 and char_length(title) between 1 and 2000 and char_length(note) <= 2000 and char_length(submitted_by) <= 200

cut_words.name: cut_words
cut_words.value: char_length(kind) <= 2000 and char_length(title) between 1 and 2000 and char_length(issue) <= 2000 and char_length(note) <= 2000

board_guest_name.name: board_guest_name
board_guest_name.value: char_length(name) between 1 and 32 and position('@' in name) = 0

plan_status.name: plan_status
plan_status.value: status is null or status in ('incomplete', 'incomplete_expired', 'trialing', 'active', 'past_due', 'canceled', 'unpaid', 'paused')

plan_ids.name: plan_ids
plan_ids.value: (customer is null or customer ~ '^cus_[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,250}$') and (subscription is null or subscription ~ '^sub_[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,250}$')

plan_tier.name: plan_tier
plan_tier.value: (tier is null or tier in ('go', 'pro', 'max')) and (item is null or item ~ '^si_[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,250}$')
